title: OL-GAP-verify-workflow-tools-exist: objection workflow-tools-exist rests on 5 unverified market cells
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** every loop pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation components --probe objection-verified:workflow-tools-exist
**Status:** open

Read the primary vendor page for each unknown cell in doctrine/market-evidence.json and set native to yes, partial or no with a source. An unknown cell never counts as support.
